summary: F1 confirms a spearphishing email (T1566.002) was delivered to n.guler@aegean.edu from aegean-edu.com.tr with an IBAN/payroll lure; no additional compromise signals (new ASN, device, rule, fatigue, bulk-SIS, or token replay) were observed in the follow-up window.

rejected_claims.claim: VPN appliance vpn-edge-01 (firmware 22.7R2.3) runs a product listed in CISA KEV (CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2025-22457, CVE-2025-0282, …)
rejected_claims.reason: critic: vpn-edge-01 did not carry a sign-in for n.guler@aegean.edu; its KEV status is not relevant to this account's exposure

actions.action: Block aegean-edu.com.tr and lookalike domains at the email gateway; retroactively search delivered mail for the same lure to other recipients.
Force password reset and MFA re-enrollment for n.guler@aegean.edu; audit sign-ins and mailbox forwarding/inbox rules.
Send targeted phishing awareness to n.guler and payroll staff; warn against IBAN update links.

limitations: Assessment relies solely on F1; no post-delivery user activity or endpoint data was correlated.
Escalation reason: model proposed escalate, evidence policy says monitor
not_checked: Mailbox audit logs, device endpoint telemetry, and DNS/proxy logs for link interaction were not reviewed.

contrastive.explanation: Rejecting F1 as unsupported would leave zero surviving signals and the policy would call this benign.

risk.rationale: Verified evidence establishes only a confirmed spearphishing email delivery (F1, T1566.002, confidence 0.8) with a financial-fraud lure (IBAN/payroll update) to n.guler@aegean.edu. This confirms exposure/initial-access attempt but does not establish a completed account takeover chain (no evidence of link click, credential entry, valid-account use, or unauthorized access). It cannot be benign (suspicious signal not explained away; rejected VPN KEV claim is irrelevant to this account). It is not weak, so monitor does not fit. Insufficient evidence to contain per the confirmed-account-takeover definition; human investigation is required to determine whether the user interacted with the message or credentials were compromised.
escalate_reasons: model proposed escalate, evidence policy says monitor
